description: Returns the next batch of work the memory left for a connected model, in this order: predicate_semantics (new attributes: one value at a time or several), media_reading (images to read: their text verbatim and what they show; the images follow as image blocks), extraction (stored documents to read into facts), fact_resolution (new facts beside the memory facts they resemble: same, replaces, contradicts or unrelated), entity_match (pairs of entities that may be one thing), fact_conflict (pairs of competing facts), fact_corroboration (pairs of facts that may state one thing twice), scene_summary (conversation scenes to summarise), safety_reading (a person’s own words read for a risk of suicide or self-harm), affect_reading (how a consenting person seemed to feel, from their own words), belief_statement (remembered states to phrase as a sentence). A batch holds the systemPrompt and userContent the server model would have been sent, the JSON schema of the reply, how many items it covers, and the signed work token its reply is submitted with, valid until expiresAt. Returns {work: null} when nothing is waiting.

kinds.description: Only these kinds; all by default

userId.description: Per-user memory scope: only this user's memory. Omit for tenant-global
